displayName: Tax Prep — Season Throughput (Theory of Constraints)
description: Activate when: returns are piling up before a deadline; reviewer/preparer is the bottleneck; 'we can't get through them all,' 'clients waiting on missing docs,' planning staffing for Jan–Apr. Do NOT activate when: off-season, low volume; the issue is a single stuck return (use debugging, not capacity theory). More: deciqai.com/c/tax-season-throughput-constraints
